explication: CCOH is a multi-cloud cost observability and optimization web application. Users register or log in, add cloud accounts, and view cost dashboards and optimization recommendations. The backend exposes authenticated API routes; account handlers trigger cost ingestion, while recommendation generation and dashboard queries are separate product stages. The README documents AWS, GCP, and Azure support, authentication, dashboard, and demo cost data. Some frontend-to-API wiring and unsampled handler behavior are not shown, so those links are omitted.
